Define the compound set starting from CHEMBL941 in molecule_dictionary, then join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno to include all salt children; also include the parent row itself. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Follow the FAQ provenance path: join compound_records on molregno, join docs on compound_records.doc_id, join activities on compound_records.record_id, join assays on activities.assay_id, join target_dictionary on assays.tid. Filter to target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Return compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles, compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. No row limit.
